name: Pictures
summary: Real photographs for designs: an agent or you searches free stock photos (Openverse, or Pexels with your key) and places one, with its photographer and licence kept.
description: Turn it on for a project whose designs need real photographs. Agents there get the design-pictures skill, this plugin's rules in their brief, and the design.picture tools; you get Stock photo in the Design view's image key. Only the search words leave this machine, to Openverse or Pexels. A placed photo keeps its credit beside the file. Switching it off takes the tools from agents and the search from the Design view; photos already placed stay, with their credit.
